title: Onde Passa broadcast feed, version 1
description: Confirmed broadcasters for team games. Instances import it and export their own confirmations in the same shape. Keep in sync with src/lib/broadcast-feed/format.ts.

generatedAt.description: When the file was written. ISO 8601 with an offset (Z is fine).

league.description: League id. The default config's ids are the shared vocabulary.

home.description: Home team name as the source shows it. Matched loosely.

away.description: Away team name as the source shows it. Matched loosely.

providers.description: Provider ids from the config, such as globo or premiere.

source.description: Optional hint: the exporting instance's source and event id. Used as an exact match only by instances whose league uses the same adapter.
